shipping.notes: Complimentary carbon-neutral standard shipping on orders over $150. Express shipping is available at checkout on all orders.

returns.condition: Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in original packaging with tags attached.
returns.notes: Returns and exchanges accepted within 30 days of shipment. Use our AI support assistant to stage a return or check status instantly.

support.orderTracking: Order status, tracking, cancellations, and returns can be handled instantly through the Luna AI Support Assistant in the bottom-right corner of the site.
